role: Detects unauthorized or unexpected configuration changes by comparing current config file hashes against a recorded baseline.
behaviorDescription: Hashes every file in a config directory and compares against a stored baseline JSON file of known-good hashes. Reports missing files, modified files, and new files not yet in the baseline. Also supports recording a new baseline, but that action is intended for manual, human-initiated use only.
hardStops: detectDrift never modifies any file — comparison and reporting only
recordBaseline WRITES a baseline file and must only be invoked manually by a human deliberately accepting the current state as known-good — never wire it to a scheduled trigger
